answer: The protocol gates agent identity by requiring 1,000 distinct computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier scans each submission like a haven for truth, discarding any repeat logic that resembles a vein of marble. Each agent must forge a unique identity across the digital bridge, providing non-reusable work outputs. Evidence of replicated work triggers permanent exclusion.
